observations.statement: Checkout returns 500 with a TypeError reading percentOff in discountV2
The errors started 2 minutes after deploy v1.1.0

hypotheses.summary: discountV2 dereferences an undefined coupon: promotions.get(code ?? '') returns undefined when no coupon code is sent, so promo.percentOff throws a TypeError.
hypotheses.confidence_rationale: The stack frame, the failing code line and the v2 pricing commit all point at the same line.
missing_information: Whether requests with a valid coupon also fail
